note: Decision record for putting raw/clean data into this repository. Sizes are computed by `python -m greek_asr.data delivery-plan` from the recorded archive listings. Update a status only when it is true in the pushed repository; never buy storage.

hparl_source_metadata.method: plain Git, `-text` so bytes are never converted
hparl_source_metadata.detail: Original Kaldi text, utt2spk, spk2utt, wav.scp and spk2gender of all three official splits; `verify-source-metadata` checks every byte hash on a clean clone.

css10_source_metadata.detail: The producer transcript.txt that the manifests use (el/transcript.txt). The second top-level copy is byte-identical (hash-checked) and listed in archive_members.tsv.

hparl_test_wav.detail: Repository owner approved the upload on 18 November 2026. Clean-clone check: `git lfs pull`, then `verify-freeze` with audio.

hparl_dev_wav.detail: Same upload as the test audio. Clean-clone check: `verify --only dev.jsonl`.

css10_used_wav.detail: Only the copy the manifests reference (el/); the byte-identical second copy is not duplicated. Clean-clone check: `verify --only css10_el_train.jsonl`.

hparl_train_wav.detail: Full train (10.68 GiB) plus the delivered audio exceeds the free LFS storage. Only the training subset that is actually used will be delivered: chosen with `python -m greek_asr.data subset` (fixed seed, whole sessions) after Serdar's measured GPU budget. Not delivered yet.
